title: Perfect Combinatorial Structures in Coding Theory and Cryptography
summary: This book develops algebraic and combinatorial methods for studying discrete structures. It brings together graph theory, Boolean functions, Fourier analysis on finite groups, coding theory, perfect colorings and perfect codes, association schemes, Latin squares, and related topics. A central theme is the interaction between different representations of the same object: combinatorial, algebraic, spectral, and coding-theoretic.
